references.filename: data/Obfuscation Through Indirect Control Flow.md
references.title: LummaC2: Obfuscation Through Indirect Control Flow
references.summary: Detailed analysis of LummaC2's control flow obfuscation using dispatcher blocks with indirect jumps. Covers three dispatcher types (register-based, memory-based, mixed-order) and three conditional dispatcher categories. Includes complete deobfuscation methodology using Triton symbolic execution engine.

key_concepts.dispatcher_blocks: Transforms control flow into scattered blocks with indirect jumps
key_concepts.backward_slicing: Technique to differentiate dispatcher vs original instructions
key_concepts.control_flow_recovery: DFS traversal to reconstruct original execution paths

use_for: understanding how to hide control flow with indirect jumps
